## How to Use This Tool

Follow our simple three-step content transmutation workflow to unlock high-fidelity social posts.

### Provide Your Source Material

Paste your raw input content directly into the editor card. This can be a rough blog post draft, notes, transcripts, or newsletters. Our AI performs best with structured inputs, but can handle loose thoughts just as effectively.

### Configure Tone & Formats

Select your target tone (Professional, Casual, Viral, Witty, or craft a custom identity) and specify your output platforms. Choose LinkedIn updates, Twitter threads, email newsletters, or Instagram captions as needed.

### Transmute and Edit

Click "Transmute Content" to process. Our AI parses and maps your input arguments to target parameters instantly. Click the "Refine" button on individual outputs to tweak, or copy results with one click.
